title: Validation
notRun: Not validated yet. Run validation to check this asset against its category's rules.

requiredFields.pass: All required fields are filled in.

naming.pass: Title and file name follow the naming convention.
naming.title: Rename this asset: titles like "untitled", "copy of" or "final final" aren't allowed.
naming.fileName: File name "{{name}}" has spaces or is a camera default. Use lowercase words joined by hyphens.

format.notAllowed: {{format}} isn't an allowed format for this category.

classification.noGroups: Share with at least one group.

rights.expiringSoon: Usage rights expire on {{date}}, within 30 days.
rights.expired: Usage rights expired on {{date}}. Downloads are blocked.

legacy.linked: The original is still in {{source}}. Migrate it before the legacy system goes read-only.

report.pass: Version and reporting period are set.
report.missing: Set both the version and the reporting period.

web.metaTooLong: Meta description is {{length}} characters; keep it under {{max}}.

email.unsubscribeNotNeeded: Internal audience: no unsubscribe link needed.
email.unsubscribeMissing: External emails need an unsubscribe link (the unsubscribe_url placeholder).
email.subjectTooLong: Subject is {{length}} characters; keep it under {{max}}.

memo.public: Memos are internal; don't classify them as Public.

pr.embargoPast: Embargo time {{date}} has passed but the release isn't approved.
pr.boilerplateOutdated: Uses boilerplate {{version}}; the current version is {{current}}.

photo.noPeople: No identifiable people, so no release is needed.
photo.releaseOk: Release on file for the people shown.
photo.releaseMissing: Identifiable people are shown but no release is on file.
photo.lowRes: Resolution {{width}}×{{height}} is below the {{min}} px minimum on the long edge.
photo.unknownRes: Resolution unknown; photos need at least {{min}} px on the long edge.

illustration.sourceMissing: Attach the layered source file (AI, PSD or similar).

infographic.textAltMissing: Add a text alternative for screen readers.
infographic.dataStale: Data as of {{date}} is more than 12 months old.
infographic.dataDateMissing: Record the date the data is valid for.

ad.disclaimerMissing: Add the regulatory disclaimer required in {{region}}.
ad.dimensionMismatch: Artwork is {{actual}} but the placement is {{expected}}.
ad.dimensionsUnknown: Artwork size unknown for the {{expected}} placement.

promo.digital: Digital format: print specs not needed.
promo.printOk: Print-ready: bleed and CMYK profile set.
promo.printSpecs: Print files need at least {{min}} mm bleed and a CMYK profile (bleed is {{bleed}} mm).

pc.transcriptPending: Add a transcript after the event.

interview.consentMissing: Record the interviewee's consent before use.
